Container.Name: manufactory-supertokens
Container.Overview: Manufactory Idle's own SuperTokens core (accounts), separate from SuperTokens---PostgreSQL. Its tables are in the manufactory_supertokens database on postgresql16. No published port: only manufactory-api reaches it, as manufactory-supertokens:3567 on pgnet. Managed by infra/unraid/deploy.sh; recreate it with deploy.sh --recreate.

Config.Name: POSTGRESQL_CONNECTION_URI
Config.Description: Postgres URL of the manufactory_supertokens role and database on postgresql16 (holds the password)

Config.Name: API_KEYS
Config.Description: The core's API key, generated by deploy.sh; manufactory-api's SUPERTOKENS_API_KEY is copied from it
